_comment: Committed performance baseline for the two hot paths (issue #31). The gate (perf/scripts/gate.mjs, run by .github/workflows/perf.yml) fails if a run's p95 exceeds the endpoint's p95_budget_ms, or its error rate exceeds max_error_rate. p95_ms/error_rate/throughput_rps are the last recorded run (regenerate with perf/scripts/capture.mjs); the budgets are fixed policy ceilings, set with headroom over both laptop and CI-runner numbers — see perf/baseline.md.

capture.environment: local dev — Docker Desktop (Postgres 16 + Mailpit), backend via spring-boot:run, JDK 21
